studies.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: empty background plate for a layered interactive 2.5D scene. Edit target: reference Moonclay Bathhouse.
Remove EVERY creature/agent and all human interface graphics, typography, sidebar, captions, portraits and UI. Reconstruct the empty water, cushions, floor and pottery they obscure. Preserve this exact warm sculpted terracotta ceramic architectural style, softly bounced honey lantern lighting, turquoise glazed cascading pools, cobalt twilight shadows, handmade curved niches and plants. The image should ONLY be the empty Bathhouse environment, no characters anywhere, no faces on objects, no words.
Reframe the environment to fill a wide landscape 3:2 frame, remove the right sidebar completely and give the Bathhouse a little breathing room at edges. Preserve the five main open pool terraces and wide water surfaces; these are traversable stages for independently composited small creatures. Reduce tall foreground obstructions enough to see the water. The pool water should be calm with restrained highlights, no complex exaggerated splashing. Keep the enchanting soft cinematic clay miniature quality of the target. No people, animals, inhabitants, sprites, logo, caption, interface. We must be able to show this exact scene with zero agents.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: empty camp background plate for layered interactive 2.5D scene. Edit target: reference Moonclay Commons camp.
Remove EVERY creature/agent and all human interface graphics, labels, navigation, header, right sidebar portrait, and the bottom character lineup. Reconstruct empty pool surfaces, cushions, paths and floor they obscure. Preserve exact architecture, warm sculpted terracotta and lightly glazed ceramic, soft golden lantern light and cobalt dusk. Image ONLY the empty camp environment, no creatures anywhere and no faces on objects, no words.
Fill landscape 3:2 composition with the seven recognizable connected camp areas: Bathhouse upper left, Dream Garden upper middle-right, Quiet House upper right, The Source mid/right, Open Studio lower right, Hearth lower center, Temple lower left. Retain central tall golden abstract flame sculpture. Give connected broad paths and terraces room for dozens of separately composited small sprites. All facilities are empty. No humans, animals, inhabitants, sprites, logo, text, UI or character lineup. Soft enchanting miniature set photography, identical Moonclay material and lighting.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent game creature atlas. Reference is the approved Moonclay creature sheet.
Make exactly eight isolated full-body creatures, just the eight LARGE primary designs from reference, one per cell in a precisely aligned 4-column by 2-row grid. Remove all smaller expression variants. First row: mint cream loopseed, terracotta sunbud, pearly violet four-point prism, cobalt braided curl. Second row: amber stacked nugget, blue tidal curl, charcoal warm-highlight comet, cream pearly sporeseed. Preserve the reference's exact happy two-eyed kawaii faces, soft sculpted clay/ceramic surfaces, blush, silhouettes, colors and soft warm upper-left lighting. All are front/three-quarter view from a slightly elevated isometric game camera.
TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background, not a solid or checkerboard background. No contact shadow, no ground, no backdrop, no labels or words. Each figure centered horizontally within its equal cell, feet aligned to same bottom baseline of its cell, plenty of transparent padding, figures about equal visual height and never touching cell edges. A wide 3:2 image. No extra creatures, no multiple views, no frames, no dividers. The eight creatures will be cut into separate cell textures in code and composited independently over an environment.
studies.usage: Unmodified source texture, clipped at draw time

Tall narrow moonlit opening toward the upper-left with a translucent linen curtain on one side, thin moonbeam across the central floor. One simple dark bronze singing bowl in a side niche.
